llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究SLM钛合金球形零件的五轴铣削表面质量，未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: No porous structure, no stress shielding analysis, no fatigue testing, no osseointegration or biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM钛合金球形件五轴铣削的表面质量影响因素。
summary_zh.method: 通过实验设计分析铣削参数对表面粗糙度和形貌的影响。
summary_zh.result: 确定了最优铣削参数组合，显著改善表面质量。
summary_zh.validation: 通过表面粗糙度测量和微观形貌观察验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of 5-axis milling parameters on surface quality of SLM Ti-6Al-4V spherical components.
summary_en.method: Experimental design with varying cutting parameters and measurement of surface roughness and morphology.
summary_en.result: Optimal milling parameters were identified, significantly improving surface finish.
summary_en.validation: Validation through surface roughness measurements and SEM observation.

papers.title: Analysis of Dialogue Stimulated by Science Videos and Reference Materials
papers.abstract: Recently, many have begun to believe that learning and training approaches known as learner-centered, active learning, and cooperative learning improve learning and practicing performance and are more effective than traditional lectures. Moreover, in addition to paper-based materials such as textbooks, face-to-face co-located communication frequently utilizes digital video and other visual reference materials. However, no previous studies have examined the precise faceto-face behavior of dialogue participants stimulated by video and other reference materials. Therefore, this paper describes the dialogue stimulated by science videos and reference materials based on data from 10 male university students measured while using first-, second-, and third-person view videos, as well as utterances recorded during the measurements.
papers.venue: Annals of Computer Science and Information Systems

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究科学视频和参考材料激发的对话行为，与有限元代理建模或生物力学设计无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, optimization under constraints, uncertainty quantification, or any biomechanical/engineering design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究科学视频和参考材料如何激发对话行为。
summary_zh.method: 基于10名男性大学生的一、二、三人称视角视频和话语记录进行分析。
summary_zh.result: 描述了视频和参考材料激发的面对面对话行为。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，仅为观察性研究。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how science videos and reference materials stimulate dialogue behavior in face-to-face settings.
summary_en.method: Data from 10 male university students were collected using first-, second-, and third-person view videos and utterance recordings.
summary_en.result: The study describes the dialogue patterns stimulated by video and reference materials.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; purely observational study.
